conformeR: conformal uncertainty quantification for LEMUR differential-expression neighborhoods

Source: R/conformeR-package.R
conformeR-package.Rd

LEMUR (lemur) fits a latent embedding of multi-condition single-cell data and identifies, for each gene, a neighborhood of cells with a consistent differential-expression response. Because these neighborhoods are estimated from data, they are subject to sampling variability. conformeR wraps the neighborhood construction in a conformal prediction framework and provides two complementary, finite-sample valid views of that uncertainty.

Workflow

  1. conformeR() fits LEMUR on a SingleCellExperiment, splits the cells into training, calibration and test sets (stratified on the design covariates), trains gene-specific classifiers of neighborhood membership, and calibrates them with conformal procedures. It returns the input SingleCellExperiment enriched with the results (altExp(sce, "conformeR"), LEMUR reduced dimensions, colData(sce)$conformeR_split and metadata(sce)$conformeR).

  2. plotter_conformal_selection() and plotter_conformal_clustering() display the results on the aligned LEMUR UMAP.

Conformal procedures and cp_alpha

Conformal selection

For each gene, selects the test cells that confidently belong to the LEMUR neighborhood. Conformal p-values are adjusted with the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure so that the false discovery rate among selected cells is controlled at cp_alpha.

Conformal clustering

For each gene and test cell, returns a prediction set of neighborhood labels (inside / outside) that contains the true label with probability at least 1 - cp_alpha. Sets of size one are confident assignments; empty sets or sets with both labels flag ambiguous cells.

Example data

sce_reduced is a small subset of the tumor-tissue drug-response dataset of Zhao et al. (2021) used in the examples and the vignette.

References

Ahlmann-Eltze, C. and Huber, W. (2025). Analysis of multi-condition single-cell data with latent embedding multivariate regression. Nature Genetics, 57, 659–667.

Jin, Y. and Candes, E. J. (2023). Selection by prediction with conformal p-values. Journal of Machine Learning Research, 24(244), 1–41.
